name: agent-terminal-hook
description: agent-terminal-hook — floating HUD for agent sessions

scripts.app:build: npm run tauri -w @ath/hud -- build --no-bundle && node scripts/stamp-exe.mjs
scripts.gen:icon: node scripts/gen-icon.mjs && npm run tauri -w @ath/hud -- icon ../../scripts/icon-source.png -o src-tauri/icons && node scripts/prune-icons.mjs
